request.text:
Show each agent's task, mode and state.
Show the questions and decisions that wait for you.
An answer you give in the page reaches the coordinator.
The coordinator's reply appears under the item it answers.

title: Live dashboard for coordinate mode
summary: See what the agents are doing and answer their questions in one page.
scope: code-better coordinate mode: the coordinator, its builders and verifiers, and a new local page. Out of scope: other modes and remote access.
